verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes found real robots.txt files returning HTTP 200 on both SCC hosts, the main site and the Clerk's Information System. Each carries an explicit 'Disallow: /' for all agents, so an agent can tell unambiguously before fetching anything that it may read nothing. The Virginia Tax probe covers a different agency and is not counted. Missing for 10: granular per-path allow rules or a sitemap pointer that would give agents more than a blanket ban, and any first-party documentation of the crawl policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service publishes a real robots.txt, so an agent can know what it may read before fetching anything
